16"""FlagGems Triton implementation of ``aten::mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight``. 

17 

18The operand is an ``MkldnnCPU`` (opaque oneDNN) conv2d weight, so this operator 

19is a pure *weight re-layout*: it re-expresses the already-packed oneDNN weights 

20in the blocked layout the mkldnn conv2d primitive expects. The convolution 

21attributes (``padding`` / ``stride`` / ``dilation`` / ``groups`` / ``input_size``) 

22only select the oneDNN weight descriptor; they do not broadcast and they never 

23change a value. Every element and dtype is preserved bit-for-bit, and the 

24result is observed through ``to_dense()``. 

25 

26The resolved-geometry contract is evaluated on the device: a real one-program 

27``@triton.jit`` guard receives the resolved shape entries (packed four to an 

28int64 word, with an unrolled fallback for entries that overflow a packed 

29field) and the operand numel, and asserts, on the accelerator, that the rank 

30is admissible, that every resolved entry is positive, and that the resolved 

31shape preserves numel. 

32 

33Semantics mirrored from the native kernel: 

34 

35* default overload - an out-of-place opaque mkldnn weight whose dense values are 

36 the operand's; the operand's own storage is untouched; 

37* ``out=`` overload - the caller's mkldnn buffer is filled (fully overwritten) 

38 and returned as the very same object; 

39* autograd - forwarding is differentiable-shaped but its derivative is 

40 not implemented, so ``backward`` raises the native ``RuntimeError``. 

41 

42The descriptor preconditions the native kernel enforces (mkldnn operand, 

43rank >= 3, supported dtype, non-empty shape, well-formed conv dims and a positive 

44group count dividing the channels, positive ``input_size`` extents) are 

45reproduced so the same ``RuntimeError``/``TypeError`` families are raised. 

46"""

92 """Device evaluation of the resolved-geometry contract of the reorder. 

93 

94 A weight re-layout is legal exactly when its rank is admissible, no 

95 resolved entry is non-positive, and the resolved numel is preserved. The 

96 eight resolved entries arrive packed four apiece in ``lo``/``hi``; padding 

97 entries are ``1`` and therefore neutral in the product. The fixed 

98 ``int64``/``int32`` annotations pin the launcher signature and 

99 ``do_not_specialize`` keeps a single compiled binary across every 

100 geometry, so the kernel can be cached and replayed directly by 

101 :func:`_packed_contract_launch`. 

102 """ 

103 e0 = lo & 0xFFFF 

104 e1 = (lo >> 16) & 0xFFFF 

105 e2 = (lo >> 32) & 0xFFFF 

106 e3 = (lo >> 48) & 0xFFFF 

107 e4 = hi & 0xFFFF 

108 e5 = (hi >> 16) & 0xFFFF 

109 e6 = (hi >> 32) & 0xFFFF

112 tl.device_assert(ndim >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: empty target geometry")

115 # evaluated at full width without a cast.

117 tl.device_assert(e0 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension") 

118 tl.device_assert(e1 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension") 

119 tl.device_assert(e2 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension") 

120 tl.device_assert(e3 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension") 

121 tl.device_assert(e4 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension") 

122 tl.device_assert(e5 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension")

124 tl.device_assert(e7 >= 1, "mkldnn reorder: non-positive resolved dimension") 

125 tl.device_assert(prod == n, "mkldnn reorder: resolved geometry changed numel")

278def _validate_full(self, padding, stride, dilation, groups, input_size): 

279 """Reproduce the native descriptor preconditions; return the operand shape.""" 

280 if not isinstance(self, torch.Tensor): 

281 raise TypeError( 

282 "mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight(): argument 'self' must be a Tensor, " 

283 f"not {type(self).__name__}"

286 raise RuntimeError( 

287 "mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight is only implemented for the MkldnnCPU " 

288 "backend; the operand must be a mkldnn tensor, but got a tensor with " 

289 f"layout {str(self.layout).rsplit('.', 1)[-1]}" 

290 ) 

291 if self.dim() < 3: 

292 raise RuntimeError( 

293 "mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight expects a weight tensor with at least " 

294 f"3 dimensions, got {self.dim()}" 

295 ) 

296 if self.dtype not in _ALLOWED_DTYPES: 

297 raise RuntimeError( 

298 f"mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight is not implemented for {self.dtype}" 

299 ) 

300 shape = tuple(self.shape) 

301 if any(d <= 0 for d in shape): 

302 raise RuntimeError( 

303 "mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight expects a non-empty weight tensor, got " 

304 f"shape {list(shape)}" 

305 ) 

306 

307 pad = _as_conv_pair(padding, "padding") 

308 strd = _as_conv_pair(stride, "stride") 

309 dil = _as_conv_pair(dilation, "dilation") 

310 if min(pad) < 0: 

311 raise RuntimeError(f"{_DESCRIPTOR_ERROR}: padding={pad}") 

312 if any(v < 1 for v in strd): 

313 raise RuntimeError(f"{_DESCRIPTOR_ERROR}: stride={strd}") 

314 if any(v < 1 for v in dil): 

315 raise RuntimeError(f"{_DESCRIPTOR_ERROR}: dilation={dil}") 

316 

317 if isinstance(groups, bool) or not isinstance(groups, int): 

318 raise TypeError(f"groups must be an integer, got {groups!r}") 

319 rank = len(shape) 

320 # The oneDNN weight descriptor needs the group count to divide the output 

321 # channels, and the input channels as well once the weight carries an 

322 # explicit spatial channel pair (rank >= 4). 

323 if groups < 1 or shape[0] % groups != 0 or (rank >= 4 and shape[1] % groups != 0): 

324 raise RuntimeError(f"{_DESCRIPTOR_ERROR}: groups={groups}") 

325 

326 if input_size is not None: 

327 if not isinstance(input_size, (list, tuple)): 

328 raise TypeError( 

329 "mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight(): argument 'input_size' must be a " 

330 f"list of ints, not {type(input_size).__name__}" 

331 ) 

332 for item in input_size: 

333 if isinstance(item, bool) or not isinstance(item, int): 

334 raise TypeError(f"input_size values must be integers, got {item!r}") 

335 if item <= 0: 

336 raise RuntimeError( 

337 f"{_DESCRIPTOR_ERROR}: input_size={list(input_size)}" 

338 ) 

339 return shape

345 The call form every real reorder uses (two-int lists for the convolution

348 operator is metadata-bound and the screening cost is part of its latency.

356 type(padding) is list

358 and type(padding[0]) is int 

359 and type(padding[1]) is int 

360 and type(stride) is list

363 and type(stride[1]) is int

366 and type(dilation[0]) is int 

367 and type(dilation[1]) is int 

368 and type(groups) is int 

369 and input_size is None

371 and self.is_mkldnn 

372 and self.dtype in _ALLOWED_DTYPES

374 shape = self.shape

405def _check_geometry(weight, out_shape): 

406 """Evaluate the resolved-geometry contract on the accelerator.""" 

407 dims = _pad_dims(out_shape) 

408 ndim = len(out_shape) 

409 n = weight.numel() 

410 if ( 

411 dims[0] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

412 and dims[1] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

413 and dims[2] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

414 and dims[3] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

415 and dims[4] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

416 and dims[5] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

417 and dims[6] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

418 and dims[7] < _PACK_FIELD_LIMIT 

419 ): 

420 lo = dims[0] | dims[1] << 16 | dims[2] << 32 | dims[3] << 48 

421 hi = dims[4] | dims[5] << 16 | dims[6] << 32 | dims[7] << 48 

422 _packed_contract_launch(torch.gcu.current_device(), n, ndim, lo, hi) 

423 else: 

424 _shape_contract_kernel_wide[(1,)](n, ndim, *dims, MAX_RANK=_MAX_RANK)
